methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly and called with a mock copy_from_env function that writes a crafted JSON result dict to a temp file. Four scenarios tested per task: (1) do-nothing — raises FileNotFoundError → score=0, passed=False; (2) partial — some flags True, below pass threshold → partial score, passed=False; (3) full — all flags True → score=100, passed=True; (4) wrong-target — all flags False → score=0, passed=False. No Android VM required.
notes: Do-nothing=0 (FileNotFoundError). Partial (name+1 friend) = 40 pts, passed=False. Full (name+4 friends) = 100 pts, passed=True. Wrong-target (all flags False) = 0 pts, passed=False.
verification_method: export_result.sh navigates to Friends page (hamburger → Friends), dumps XML; navigates to Settings (hamburger → Settings), dumps XML; greps for distinctive keywords; writes JSON result to /sdcard/<task>_result.json. Verifier copies JSON via copy_from_env and checks boolean flags.
